metadata_scope: frozen protocol contract, not evidence of unrun-cell completion
new_refit_label_universe: Scarcity: all 34 labels. LOFO: 34 minus the held-out family's labels; known-label macro-F1 does not score unknown-family labels as known classes.
rarity_formula: positive class support <= max(1, ceil(0.01 * uncapped reference rows)); if no class qualifies, select up to eight least-supported present classes
old_rare_definition_text_is_approximate: Some cell metadata says 'below 1%'; the authoritative code has always used inclusive <= ceil threshold, not strict <.
new_refit_rarity_reference: Uncapped fit pool after removal of held-out LOFO family; never recomputed after scarcity cap

capture_protocol.authorization: New hierarchy family/local refits explicitly authorized after the bounded diagnostic; fresh flat models and calibrators reused without refitting
capture_protocol.base_role: frozen files 1-45; same 720747 rows, no extra cap
capture_protocol.calibrator_role: existing utility files 46-50; no new calibrator fit
capture_protocol.selection_role: files 51-54 excluded from all new fits and map selection
capture_protocol.test_role: all four windows; prediction/metrics only, no fitting or tuning
capture_protocol.rarity_definition: inclusive one-percent threshold in original base-file source counts; not selected-base support
capture_protocol.removed_from_formal_competitors: legacy_flat_xgb is retained only in original audit CSVs; real_taxonomy is the ninth formal arm
capture_protocol.ece_bins: equal-width right-closed, zero in first bin, row-share weighted

capture_rarity_reference: source_rows per class in original base-file counts, not the selected 720747-row base sample

fit_and_reuse_scope.lofo_scarcity: Per-cell fresh flat XGB/LGBM and real/cyclic hierarchy bundles; derived blends and calibration-only temperature/stacker controls use exactly matched grouped rows
fit_and_reuse_scope.calibration_alert_budget: All ten arms recomputed from strictly aligned frozen probabilities; no new base or meta-model fitting
fit_and_reuse_scope.capture_fresh_model_fitting: Three new family/local LGBM hierarchy bundles, 380 trees each component; flat XGB 520, flat LGBM 380 and temperature/stacker checkpoints reused unchanged
fit_and_reuse_scope.capture_reuse_checks: All fresh five-arm cached results exactly preserved; source-row/class alignment audited for all 28 parts; blend probabilities exactly equal .5 times the shared current-flat probability plus .5 hierarchy probability
fit_and_reuse_scope.capture_comparison_boundary: Same current fitted flat component, same base rows and 39 predictors; all three maps frozen before new fits, all four windows included without tuning

capture_legacy_method_aliases.status: retired audit-only IDs; source reused gate-like names for fixed blends

meta_model.temperature_log_bound_optimizer: bounded minimize_scalar, xatol=1e-4, multiclass log loss

scarcity_label_budget: base-fitting cap only; utility/calibration labels additional; not a total annotation-budget study

uncertainty_and_ci_assumptions.lofo_scarcity_unit: three seed summaries, each an equal-weight mean across its seven families or six caps
uncertainty_and_ci_assumptions.core_e3_e4_unit: six grouped outer-test split summaries; shared source observations are not independent population samples
uncertainty_and_ci_assumptions.capture_unit: four dependent file-order windows, one seed/fitted pair; any SD is window variability, not a four-replicate CI

runtime_only_changes: independent output roots, two-thread limits, resource admission, checkpoint ownership and atomic final merge; frozen model/sample parameters unchanged
